nodes.title: SG-2 · Remove execution, approve and retry routes from the server
nodes.body:
Context: Worldseed must not host development automation. The execution package and the worker module are already deleted, and server.New currently mounts only player, world, contribution and admin round routes. Desired behavior: the server package neither registers nor implements execution, approve or retry routes, and wires no execution or worker dependencies. Expected result: remaining server tests pass with all dependencies mocked, and the contribution and round routes are unchanged. Why: development automation lives in the devion project workseed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given server.New, when /api/v1/admin/executions, /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve and /retry are requested with a valid admin token, then the response is 404 or 405 and no execution handler runs
- Given the backend/internal/server package, when its Go sources are scanned, then none references internal/execution, storyforge/worker, or an execution handler
- Given the remaining server tests run with mocks, when go test ./internal/server runs, then all pass
- Given the contribution and round routes, when requested, then their statuses and bodies are identical to before


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server_test.go
- In scope: backend/internal/server/removed_code_test.go
- Out of scope: backend/internal/contribution behavior
- Out of scope: round lifecycle behavior
- Out of scope: game/ and frontend
- Preserve: POST /api/v1/contributions
- Preserve: GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions
- Preserve: GET /api/v1/contributions/{id}
- Preserve: admin round routes and token middleware
- Preserve: round/current route


## Technical constraints
- Go module backend; chi router; do not change contribution or round route patterns


## Definition of done
- No execution, approve or retry route or wiring in backend/internal/server
- go test ./internal/server passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · server.New registers and implements no execution, approve or retry routes
nodes.body:
Context: server.New builds routes under /api/v1/admin from adminRoundRoutes. Desired behavior: that table lists only the five round routes and New builds no execution store, handler, worker or config dependency. Expected result: execution, approve and retry paths are unreachable. Why: remove development automation from the server.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given server.New, when GET /api/v1/admin/executions and POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/approve and /retry are sent with the admin token, then the status is 404 or 405
- Given adminRoundRoutes, when listed, then it has exactly the five round routes (create, open, close, get, contributions)
- Given the server sources, when scanned, then no execution or worker import remains


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go
- Out of scope: contribution routes
- Preserve: adminRoute struct and adminRoundRoutes table shape


## Technical constraints
- Keep admin.Middleware on /api/v1/admin


## Definition of done
- server.go has no execution wiring


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Contribution, player, world and round routes are unchanged
nodes.body:
Context: contribution intake and round lifecycle must stay intact. Desired behavior: server.New still mounts healthz, player session/me, world routes, round/current, contribution create/mine/get and admin round routes with the same handlers. Expected result: unchanged statuses and bodies. Why: owner-kept features must not regress.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given server.New, when POST /api/v1/contributions, GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions and GET /api/v1/contributions/{id} are sent, then they reach the contribution handlers
- Given server.New, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current and admin round routes are sent, then the existing statuses are returned


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go
- Out of scope: handler implementations
- Preserve: all route patterns in server.New


## Technical constraints
- No change to route patterns or handler wiring


## Definition of done
- Route registrations for kept routes are unmodified


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Server tests have no execution cases, pass with mocked dependencies and guard against reintroduction
nodes.body:
Context: server_test.go and removed_code_test.go already cover kept routes and scan for removed imports. Desired behavior: no execution route test remains, tests use temp dirs and a fake git, and the guard tests assert absence of internal/execution and storyforge/worker. Expected result: go test ./internal/server is green. Why: proof the removal is complete.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given server_test.go, when searched, then no test names or exercises execution, approve or retry routes
- Given go test ./internal/server, when run, then all tests pass using only temp dirs and no network
- Given a reintroduced execution import, when the guard test runs, then it fails


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server_test.go
- In scope: backend/internal/server/removed_code_test.go
- Out of scope: other packages' tests
- Preserve: existing kept-route tests


## Technical constraints
- Tests mock Git and use t.TempDir


## Definition of done
- Server tests green


## Clarifying questions
- None
